badge.label: AI-generated — review before publishing
badge.hint: This content was produced by the AI assistant and has not been edited or approved by a person yet. Check it carefully.

generate.title: Generate a process with AI
generate.intro: Describe the process in your own words — who is involved, the main steps, decisions and systems. Arabic or English. The assistant builds a BPMN diagram with lanes and labels in both languages; you review it before anything is saved.
generate.placeholder: e.g. Build a process for employee onboarding with HR, IT and the line manager. HR creates the employee record in SAP, IT prepares the laptop and accounts…
generate.inserted: The generated diagram was inserted and saved as a draft.
generate.attached_one: A generated diagram with {{count}} suggested link will be saved as the draft model.
generate.attached_other: A generated diagram with {{count}} suggested links will be saved as the draft model.
generate.replaces: Inserting replaces the current diagram. Save a version first if you want to keep it.
generate.linksHint: Steps are linked to existing roles and IT systems with the same name. Untick what does not fit.
generate.noLinks: No matching roles or systems in the library.
generate.unmatchedHint: Add them to the Roles or IT systems library if they should be reused, then link them in the modeler.

translate.label: Label
translate.reviewHint: Only labels missing in this language are shown. Edit anything that is not right, then apply — you can still undo in the modeler.
translate.applied: Translations applied. Review the diagram and save.
translate.nothingMissing: Every label already exists in this language.
translate.fieldsFilled: The empty fields were filled — review them before saving.

settings.title: AI assistant
settings.intro: The assistant generates and refines processes, writes documentation, translates between Arabic and English, analyses processes and answers questions in the Knowledge Portal. Requests go from the server to the AI provider; the API key never reaches the browser. Every request is logged.
settings.modelHint: Used for generation, refinement and analysis. Default: {{model}}
settings.fastModelHint: Used for small tasks such as translating labels. Default: {{model}}
settings.apiKeyHint: Stored encrypted (AES-256-GCM); it is never shown again.
settings.apiKeyStored: A key is stored (encrypted). Type a new one only to replace it.
settings.removeKeyText: The assistant is switched off until a new key is entered.
settings.noEncryptionKey: INTEGRATIONS_ENCRYPTION_KEY is not set: the API key cannot be stored.
settings.rolesHint: Users with one of these roles see the ✨ AI buttons. Portal Q&A needs the Viewer role ticked for portal-only users.
settings.orgMonthlyLimit: Requests for the organisation per month
settings.suggestionsHint: Sample prompts shown as clickable chips for each feature (up to six).

usage.title: AI usage
usage.subtitle: Requests and tokens per user, feature, model and month (UTC).
usage.empty: No AI requests in this month

summary.title: Summary
summary.noChanges: Nothing changed between these versions (apart from the layout).
summary.instructions: Instructions, e.g. for whom and how long

chat.empty: Ask for a change to this diagram, e.g. “add an approval step by the finance manager after step 3”. You review every proposal before it is applied.
chat.placeholder: Describe a change… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)
chat.layoutHint: Accepting replaces the diagram with the proposal (automatic layout) and saves it as a draft. Links to roles and systems stay on unchanged steps.
chat.dropped_one: {{count}} element (e.g. an annotation or boundary event) cannot be edited by the assistant and will be removed.
chat.dropped_other: {{count}} elements (e.g. annotations or boundary events) cannot be edited by the assistant and will be removed.

doc.title: Documentation from this process
doc.intro: The assistant writes a document for {{process}} in English and Arabic, from the diagram, its roles, IT systems and documents. You preview it before the page is created.
doc.noSpace: You cannot edit any documentation space.
doc.created: The page was created as a draft, linked to the process.
doc.changeNote: Generated by the AI assistant from process {{code}}

fromPage.button: Create a process from this page
fromPage.title: Process from this page
fromPage.intro: The assistant models the process described in “{{title}}” as a BPMN diagram with lanes. You review it, then create the process (linked to this page).
fromPage.placeholder: Optional instructions, e.g. “only the approval part”
